name: ru.yoomoney.sdk.qr_sdk.barcodeRecognize.ui.BarcodeScannerActivity
description: The YooMoney QR SDK opens this Activity when a user starts its camera scanner. It scans QR codes and barcodes used to pay bills, transfer money, or sign in, then returns the recognized result to the app.
disableEffect: Users cannot scan payment or sign-in codes with the YooMoney QR feature.
